PRE-LAUNCH PREVIEW · CONTENT & INTEGRATIONS IN REVIEW
Promotional Products and Merchandise

Give your brand something people can keep.

Bring the brand into events, customer gifting and team kits with merchandise concepts, artwork and coordinated supplier briefs.

The problem behind the brief.

Merchandise should have a purpose beyond adding a logo. Product choice, quality, quantities and delivery dates need to fit the people receiving it.

Our approach

Define the occasion and budget, shortlist suitable products and prepare the artwork. Coordinate supplier quotes, samples and approvals before any production commitment.

What we deliver.

Branded apparel and team merchandise

Drinkware, bags and stationery concepts

Event giveaways and welcome-kit planning

Promotional product selection and sourcing coordination

Print-ready artwork and digital proofs

Packaging and branded insert design

Supplier, sample and fulfilment coordination

Quantity, budget and delivery planning

Tools, chosen for the job

Product briefs · artwork specifications · supplier proofs

Final stack depends on your systems, requirements and budget.

Measurement

Approved proofs · budget alignment · delivery milestones

Baselines and targets are agreed during discovery.

Good questions.

What is included in the engagement?

Product availability, minimum quantities, samples, production, shipping and any third-party supplier costs are confirmed by quote. Production begins only after client approval.

How do we get started?

Share your business goal, current channels and constraints. We agree the deliverables, responsibilities, budget and schedule before work begins.

How will progress be measured?

We agree a baseline and a reporting rhythm around approved proofs · budget alignment · delivery milestones. Targets follow discovery and the agreed scope; results are not guaranteed.
